I've updated GBrain and replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread.

- **Record fixed:** Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is now saved as 100 seats. The entry notes Ilse as the source and links to both of her messages.
- **Old figure retired:** I removed the earlier 261-seat entry from her #north-team post. It's kept in the history but no longer comes back in searches. That check matched exact words only, so a reworded copy of the 261 figure could have been missed. None turned up.
- **Reply:** I thanked Ilse, confirmed the change, and said nothing else is needed. I also told her I haven't checked the 100 against the signed contract.

Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, so posting the number in #north-random was fine. June Osei-Lark, the one person there outside the North team, is deal desk, which is an org-wide role. I didn't read any other channels or send mail.
